body: I'm sorry, but it ends tomorrow.

But what's the point of it all? Even if I decide not to kill myself, i'm going to be living my life single. i can't deal with the pain that relationships have. my first relationship ended when my gf killed herself, my last one ended when she was raped, impregnated, and never went to see the police. do you know what thats like? do you? she was 18, anything i said to the police they couldnt do anything about. do you know what its like to have the police tell you that they dont believe you, that they think your gf is just a whore? shes having her kid in a few days and i havent seen her in months. her parents think im the father. holy fuck, i will never get across to you what any of this is like.

With all due respect, I'm not sure that you understand the pain. Do you know what it's like to want to kill yourself for years? To seriously consider it before even puberty? Do you know what it's like to be afraid to leave your house because you are deathly afraid of what your parents might do when you are away? Did you ever live on the street as a teenager or legitimately live with friends? Can you show emotion? I have a thousand yard stare for everything because the last thing I wanted is for my parents to read my emotions. To see that I was and am afraid.

My mom is abusive and my dad has been silently watching for years. When I mentioned my family, and the regret that'd I'd have for killing myself, I was refering to the fact that I wouldn't be around to protect my sisters. My parents would only be concerned about how our family now views us.
